objects.description: World objects placed like plants: fires, shelters, the sun and the moon

name.description: The name of the object; levels and rules use it

frame.description: The picture the game draws it with

blocks.description: true: it blocks walking like a rock

inspect.description: The text shown when the player looks at it
inspect.example: A ring of stones around old ash.

tags.description: Tags the object carries: what rules may do to it

states.description: The states it moves through; the first is where it starts

light.description: A kind of light of lights.json the object gives

lightState.description: It gives its light only while it is in this state (a fire pit: burning); empty: always

celestial.description: Makes the object a sun or a moon: its light, orbit and height

light.description: The kind of light of lights.json the sun or the moon gives

follows.description: clock: the body travels its orbit by the game clock; fixed: it stays where it is placed

orbitRadius.description: How far away a clock body is, in metres

tilt.description: Degrees that turn the orbit round the vertical: the sun rises a little north or south of east

height.description: Metres above the ground; a body that follows the clock takes its height from its orbit

shadow.description: false: casts no shadow whatever its height
